units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 7|Thanks to the work of your crew, the atmosphere on the ship is brought to human standards, if a bit tropical. As the salvage continues, you and your crew start to become familiar with the ship. Its strong hull appears spaceworthy, but the ship has barely any weapons, the battery systems are beyond repair, and shield regeneration is impossible. If the Mereti attack, the <EDC-ship> won't be able to survive long.|516|0

units.raw: `Thanks to the work of your crew, the atmosphere on the ship is brought to human standards, if a bit tropical. As the salvage continues, you and your crew start to become familiar with the ship. Its strong hull appears spaceworthy, but the ship has barely any weapons, the battery systems are beyond repair, and shield regeneration is impossible. If the Mereti attack, the <EDC-ship> won't be able to survive long.`

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 7|	The tent is larger than you expected. At the back there is a group of Korath arranged like a choir, but standing oddly still. A Korath in some kind of robe stands next to a table piled with sweets and cups of some kind of thick drink. As you approach, you realize that the "choir" is made of holograms. You do a quick mental count and guess that these are the Korath that died on the ship; this is probably some type of memorial. The Korath in robes greets you and presses a cup into your hand.|550|0

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 7|	The drink is fermented, and has a sweet and sour taste that leaves your lips and mouth tingling, eventually numbing them. units.raw: `	The drink is fermented, and has a sweet and sour taste that leaves your lips and mouth tingling, eventually numbing them. When you finish the food, you take your leave and return to your ship.`
